entries.notes: Large browser regression monolith; bond drawing plus homogeneous, bond/arrow mixed-object, and nested mixed-group clipboard paths are migrated into formal scenarios. Existing gate remains active.

Production evidence uses real Save As/Open toolbar actions, native Windows dialogs, guarded mouse/keyboard/text input, dirty-tab close with explicit Don't Save, guest-to-host SHA-256 transfer, independent CLI chemical validation, disk reopen, and continued editing. Other formats, multi-tab interactions, overwrite/error paths, autosave/recovery, and large documents remain.

Production evidence covers solid arrows created through real mouse input in mixed selection, region/additive selection, nested-group, locked partial-delete, same-/cross-type locked transforms, locked-group, and multi-property workflows; remaining arrow variants and properties remain.

Production evidence uses public nested context menus to change two selected arrows from plain to bold and from full to half-left end heads, proves uniform engine-derived checked states after each mutation, and independently undoes and redoes both transactions. Variants, sizes, curvature, tails, no-go markers, color, mixed values, locks, persistence, and large documents remain.

Production evidence covers homogeneous molecule/bond objects, mixed molecule/bond/arrow selection, copied nested roots, locked/unlocked pairs, a locked group mixed with an editable root, and repeated two-arrow property selection across history; remaining object types and selection modes are still required.

Production evidence covers mixed molecule/arrow select-all, region and Shift-additive cardinalities, clipboard, history, grouping, nesting, batch ungroup, and locked/editable partial movement; additional object types and partial applicability remain.

Production evidence covers Ctrl+G and Ctrl+Shift+G for mixed groups, two nested roots, selection preservation, and grouped-arrow transform behavior before and after Lock; context-menu grouping, other object classes, hidden members, and persistence remain.

Production evidence covers depth-two molecule/arrow hierarchy creation, Windows clipboard duplication, structural DOM nesting, batch outer ungroup, and retained inner groups; deeper nesting, cross-group movement, transforms, save/reopen, and import/export remain.
Production evidence covers same-document homogeneous, mixed, and nested duplication plus mixed-object copy into a newly created document tab; cross-surface cells remain.

Production evidence locks GUI-created arrows, a molecule, and a group through the public context menu, observes and applies Unlock, preserves effective lock through mixed deletion and movement, and restores movement after Unlock. Text objects, persistence, and other mutation commands remain.

Production evidence covers real pointer movement of locked/editable arrow and molecule/arrow pairs plus a locked group ancestor, exact semantic world-coordinate stationary/moved checks, one-step undo/redo, public Unlock, and subsequent movement of all editable members. Rotation, resize, alignment/distribution, text, and large documents remain.

Production evidence creates a two-child group, locks the parent through its public context menu, proves both descendants remain stationary while an editable root moves across drag/undo/redo, then unlocks the parent and proves all three objects move. Nested locked ancestors, partial descendant selection, deletion, properties, save/reopen, and import/export remain.

Production evidence covers atomic homogeneous and mixed bond/arrow deletion, zero/one/two/many region and Shift-additive selection, plus locked/unlocked partial applicability with one-step undo/redo; grouped, nested, hidden, overlapping, and large-document deletion cells remain.

Production evidence now covers empty, single, heterogeneous pair, and Shift-additive many-object region selection with deletion and history transitions; further object types, hidden/locked objects, cross-group movement, and partial viewport coverage remain.
Production evidence covers mixed-object copy from one in-app document tab into a newly created blank tab; browser/desktop, Office, paste-special, and independently opened document boundaries remain.

Production evidence now covers a locked/unlocked arrow pair, real context-menu locking, partial deletion, and one-step undo/redo. Grouped/nested, hidden, overlapping, other object classes, locked ancestors, and large-document production cells remain.
